data.title: Fe'l Maazi Majhool Wahid se Jama (أُخْرِجَ ← أُخْرِجُوا)
rows: Woh apne gharon se nikaale gaye
Jo Allah ki raah mein shaheed kiye gaye
Jab unhein naseehat ki jati hai

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 156–158):** Guzishta sabaq mein aapne Maazi Majhool Wahid (`أُخْرِجَ` usey nikala gaya, `قُتِلَ` woh qatl kiya gaya) padha tha. Usi fe'l ke aakhir mein **`وْا`** ka izafa karne se woh jama ke liye (**'Un logon ko ... kiya gaya'**) ban jata hai: `أُخْرِجُوا` (unhein nikala gaya), `قُتِلُوا` (woh qatl kiye gaye), `ذُكِّرُوا` (unhein naseehat ki gayi). Isi tarah `أُوتِيَ` (usey diya gaya) se **`أُوتُوا`** (unhein diya gaya) banta hai, jo Qur'an Majeed mein `الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ` aur `الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ` ke khaas muhaware ke taur par bakasrat aata hai.
